rule.statement: A constructive trust arises by operation of law upon the execution of a deed, where the legal title resides in the trustee while the beneficial ownership remains with the claimant.
rule.supporting_quote: A constructive trust accordingly arose by operation of law upon the execution of Deed No. 1853, by which the Defendant holds and has at all times held Lot 2 as trustee for the beneficial ownership of the Plaintiff.
